SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_account, u.e_mail, u.detail_address, u.user_phone, u.cumulative_volunteer_time, u.month_volunteer_time, u.volunteer_count, u.deactivation_times, u.user_status, u.activation_date, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM adoptionPost UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM missingPost UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM post UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM sightingPost UNION ALL SELECT vaad.user_id FROM volunteerPost vp JOIN volunteerassociationapplicationdetails vaad ON vp.volappdetail_id = vaad.id ) p WHERE p.user_id = u.user_id ) AS post_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM adoptionPostComment UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM donationPostComment UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM missingPostComment UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM postComment UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM sightingPostComment UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM volunteerPostComment ) p WHERE p.user_id = u.user_id ) AS comment_count,
u.rating_id, r.name as rating_name,
d.sido_name, g.sigungu_name,
l.id as login_id, l.ip_address, l.logged_at
FROM user AS u LEFT JOIN rating AS r ON (u.rating_id = r.id) LEFT JOIN sigungu AS g ON (u.sigungu_id = g.sigungu_id) LEFT JOIN sido AS d ON (g.sido_id = d.sido_id) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lh1.id, lh1.ip_address, lh1.logged_at, lh1.user_id FROM loginhistory as lh1 WHERE lh1.logged_at = ( SELECT MAX(lh2.logged_at) FROM loginHistory lh2 WHERE lh2.user_id = lh1.user_id ) ) AS l ON(u.user_id = l.user_id)
u.rating_id BETWEEN 0 AND 3
AND u.user_status = 'GENERAL'
AND u.user_status = 'BLACK'
AND u.user_status = 'CANCEL'

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_account, u.e_mail, u.detail_address, u.user_phone, u.cumulative_volunteer_time, u.month_volunteer_time, u.volunteer_count, u.deactivation_times, u.user_status, u.activation_date, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM adoptionPost UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM missingPost UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM post UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM sightingPost UNION ALL SELECT vaad.user_id FROM volunteerPost vp JOIN volunteerassociationapplicationdetails vaad ON vp.volappdetail_id = vaad.id ) p WHERE p.user_id = u.user_id ) AS post_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM adoptionPostComment UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM donationPostComment UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM missingPostComment UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM postComment UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM sightingPostComment UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM volunteerPostComment ) p WHERE p.user_id = u.user_id ) AS comment_count,
u.rating_id, r.name as rating_name,
d.sido_name, g.sigungu_name,
l.id as login_id, l.ip_address, l.logged_at
FROM user AS u LEFT JOIN rating AS r ON (u.rating_id = r.id) LEFT JOIN sigungu AS g ON (u.sigungu_id = g.sigungu_id) LEFT JOIN sido AS d ON (g.sido_id = d.sido_id) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lh1.id, lh1.ip_address, lh1.logged_at, lh1.user_id FROM loginhistory as lh1 WHERE lh1.logged_at = ( SELECT MAX(lh2.logged_at) FROM loginHistory lh2 WHERE lh2.user_id = lh1.user_id ) ) AS l ON(u.user_id = l.user_id)
rating_id NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 3

SELECT sh.head_id, sh.ceo_name, sh.ceo_name2, sh.head_account, sh.e_mail, sh.head_phone, sh.company_name, sh.biz_number, sh.cor_number, sh.company_address, sh.open_date, sh.close_date,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT head_id FROM adoptionPost UNION ALL SELECT head_id FROM donationPost UNION ALL SELECT head_id FROM missingPost UNION ALL SELECT head_id FROM post UNION ALL SELECT head_id FROM sightingPost ) p WHERE p.head_id = sh.head_id ) AS post_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT head_id FROM adoptionPostComment UNION ALL SELECT head_id FROM donationPostComment UNION ALL SELECT head_id FROM missingPostComment UNION ALL SELECT head_id FROM postComment UNION ALL SELECT head_id FROM sightingPostComment UNION ALL SELECT head_id FROM volunteerPostComment ) p WHERE p.head_id = sh.head_id ) AS comment_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteerassociation as va WHERE va.head_id = sh.head_id ) AS volunteer_count,
g.sigungu_name, d.sido_name,
l.id as login_id, l.ip_address, l.logged_at
FROM shelter_head AS sh LEFT JOIN sigungu AS g ON (sh.sigungu_id = g.sigungu_id) LEFT JOIN sido AS d ON (g.sido_id = d.sido_id) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lh1.id, lh1.ip_address, lh1.logged_at, lh1.head_id FROM loginhistory as lh1 WHERE lh1.logged_at = ( SELECT MAX(lh2.logged_at) FROM loginHistory lh2 WHERE lh2.head_id = lh1.head_id ) ) AS l ON(sh.head_id = l.head_id)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT post_id AS id FROM postReport WHERE status = FALSE GROUP BY post_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT post_id AS id FROM adoptionPostReport WHERE status = FALSE GROUP BY post_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT post_id AS id FROM missingPostReport WHERE status = FALSE GROUP BY post_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT post_id AS id FROM sightingPostReport WHERE status = FALSE GROUP BY post_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT post_id AS id FROM volunteerPostReport WHERE status = FALSE GROUP BY post_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) AS post_reports;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT comment_id AS id FROM postCommentReport WHERE status = FALSE GROUP BY comment_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT comment_id AS id FROM adoptionPostCommentReport WHERE status = FALSE GROUP BY comment_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT comment_id AS id FROM donationPostCommentReport WHERE status = FALSE GROUP BY comment_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT comment_id AS id FROM missingPostCommentReport WHERE status = FALSE GROUP BY comment_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT comment_id AS id FROM sightingPostCommentReport WHERE status = FALSE GROUP BY comment_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT comment_id AS id FROM volunteerPostCommentReport WHERE status = FALSE GROUP BY comment_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) AS comment_reports;

-- 입양 게시판 SELECT ap.id , ap.title , COALESCE(u.user_name, sh.company_name) as writer , 'adoption' AS category , ap.is_blind , ap.created_at , ap.view , Count(apr.id) as report_count FROM adoptionpostreport AS apr JOIN adoptionpost AS ap ON (apr.post_id = ap.id) LEFT JOIN user AS u ON (ap.user_id = u.user_id) LEFT JOIN shelter_head AS sh ON (ap.head_id = sh.head_id) GROUP BY ap.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN apr.status = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
UNION ALL
-- 실종 SELECT mp.id , mp.title , COALESCE(u.user_name, sh.company_name) as writer , 'missing' AS category , mp.is_blinded , mp.created_at , mp.view , Count(mpr.id) as report_count FROM missingpostreport AS mpr JOIN missingpost AS mp ON (mpr.post_id = mp.id) LEFT JOIN user AS u ON (mp.user_id = u.user_id) LEFT JOIN shelter_head AS sh ON (mp.head_id = sh.head_id) GROUP BY mp.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN mpr.status = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
UNION ALL
-- 자유 SELECT p.id , p.title , COALESCE(u.user_name, sh.company_name) as writer , 'post' AS category , p.is_blinded , p.created_at , p.view , Count(pr.id) as report_count FROM postreport AS pr JOIN post AS p ON (pr.post_id = p.id) LEFT JOIN user AS u ON (p.user_id = u.user_id) LEFT JOIN shelter_head AS sh ON (p.head_id = sh.head_id) GROUP BY p.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pr.status = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
UNION ALL
-- 목격 SELECT sp.id , sp.title , COALESCE(u.user_name, sh.company_name) as writer , 'sighting' AS category , sp.is_blinded , sp.created_at , sp.view , Count(spr.id) as report_count FROM sightingpostreport AS spr JOIN sightingpost AS sp ON (spr.post_id = sp.id) LEFT JOIN user AS u ON (sp.user_id = u.user_id) LEFT JOIN shelter_head AS sh ON (sp.head_id = sh.head_id) GROUP BY sp.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN spr.status = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
UNION ALL
-- 봉사 SELECT vp.id , vp.title , u.user_name as writer , 'volunteer' AS category , vp.is_blinded , vp.created_at , vp.view , Count(vpr.id) as report_count FROM volunteerpostreport AS vpr JOIN volunteerpost AS vp ON (vpr.post_id = vp.id) LEFT JOIN volunteerassociationapplicationdetails AS vaad ON (vaad.id = vp.volappdetail_id) LEFT JOIN user AS u ON (vaad.user_id = u.user_id) GROUP BY vp.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN vpr.status = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5

-- 입양 SELECT apc.id , apc.content , COALESCE(u.user_name, sh.company_name) as writer , 'adoption' AS category , apc.is_blinded , apc.created_at , apc.post_id , Count(apcr.id) as report_count FROM adoptionpostcommentreport AS apcr JOIN adoptionpostcomment AS apc ON (apcr.comment_id = apc.id) LEFT JOIN user AS u ON (apc.user_id = u.user_id) LEFT JOIN shelter_head AS sh ON (apc.head_id = sh.head_id) GROUP BY apc.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN apcr.status = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
UNION ALL -- 후원 SELECT dpc.id , dpc.content , COALESCE(u.user_name, sh.company_name) as writer , 'donation' AS category , dpc.is_blinded , dpc.created_at , dpc.post_id , Count(dpcr.id) as report_count FROM donationpostcommentreport AS dpcr JOIN donationpostcomment AS dpc ON (dpcr.comment_id = dpc.id) LEFT JOIN user AS u ON (dpc.user_id = u.user_id) LEFT JOIN shelter_head AS sh ON (dpc.head_id = sh.head_id) GROUP BY dpc.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN dpcr.status = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
UNION ALL
-- 실종 SELECT mpc.id , mpc.content , COALESCE(u.user_name, sh.company_name) as writer , 'missing' AS category , mpc.is_blinded , mpc.created_at , mpc.post_id , Count(mpcr.id) as report_count FROM missingpostcommentreport AS mpcr JOIN missingpostcomment AS mpc ON (mpcr.comment_id = mpc.id) LEFT JOIN user AS u ON (mpc.user_id = u.user_id) LEFT JOIN shelter_head AS sh ON (mpc.head_id = sh.head_id) GROUP BY mpc.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN mpcr.status = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
UNION ALL -- 자유 SELECT pc.id , pc.content , COALESCE(u.user_name, sh.company_name) as writer , 'post' AS category , pc.is_blinded , pc.created_at , pc.post_id , Count(pcr.id) as report_count FROM postcommentreport AS pcr JOIN postcomment AS pc ON (pcr.comment_id = pc.id) LEFT JOIN user AS u ON (pc.user_id = u.user_id) LEFT JOIN shelter_head AS sh ON (pc.head_id = sh.head_id) GROUP BY pc.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pcr.status = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
UNION ALL
-- 목격 SELECT spc.id , spc.content , COALESCE(u.user_name, sh.company_name) as writer , 'sighting' AS category , spc.is_blinded , spc.created_at , spc.post_id , Count(spcr.id) as report_count FROM sightingpostcommentreport AS spcr JOIN sightingpostcomment AS spc ON (spcr.comment_id = spc.id) LEFT JOIN user AS u ON (spc.user_id = u.user_id) LEFT JOIN shelter_head AS sh ON (spc.head_id = sh.head_id) GROUP BY spc.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN spcr.status = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
